title: Strategy IR v1
description: Intermediate representation for a backtestable trading strategy. This is the contract between the LLM translation layer and the safe interpreter — the interpreter must reject anything that passes schema validation but isn't semantically valid (e.g. an operand string that names neither a known indicator nor a price field).

asset_class.description: Asset class — drives which data source and cost model to use.

indicators.description: Ordered list of named indicator series. Each id must be unique; ids are referenced by operands in entry/exit conditions.

entry.description: Boolean expression that, when true at bar t, triggers a buy at bar t+1 (no-lookahead convention).

exit.description: Boolean expression that, when true at bar t, triggers a sell at bar t+1.

oneOf.description: Stop-loss as a fraction of entry price (0.05 = 5%). Null = no stop-loss.
Take-profit as a fraction of entry price (0.10 = 10%). Null = no take-profit.

risk.description: Risk management parameters. Null or absent = no stops.

price_field.description: A raw OHLC price field usable as an indicator source or condition operand.

indicator_type.description: Whitelisted indicator types. RSI uses Wilder's smoothing (RMA). SMA is a simple rolling mean. EMA uses alpha=2/(period+1).

id.description: Unique identifier referenced in condition operands, e.g. 'rsi14' or 'sma200'.

source.description: The price series this indicator is computed from.

oneOf.description: Indicator id (e.g. 'rsi14') or price field (e.g. 'close'). Resolved by the interpreter at runtime — the schema cannot enumerate user-defined indicator ids.

comparison.description: A single boolean comparison between two operands.

op.description: Comparison operator. crosses_above/below check for the transition on the current bar vs. the previous bar.

condition.description: A boolean expression: either a logical combinator (all_of / any_of) over sub-conditions, or a leaf comparison.

all_of.description: Logical AND: true when every sub-condition is true.

any_of.description: Logical OR: true when at least one sub-condition is true.
